rationale: EXPORTS_JAVA2 (M14 ontology). An `exports` edge asserts IMPORTABILITY, and a top-level type is importable from another compilation unit iff it is declared public (JLS 6.5.5.1, 7.6). So the 1.0 tier is the public top-level types and the 0.6 tier is the package-private ones; both tiers are live on the corpus (public 2565 / no-modifier 718 of 3289 entries on java-lib), so neither is a dead branch. Members are NOT exported: `import Api` binds the type, never a bare member name, and membership already rides `contains` (M49 JVM-closure exports-family ruling, reviews/jvm-closure-audit.md). The 0.6 tier carries a machine-readable reasonCode as honesty-contract §4 requires of any sub-1.0 edge, and sits below the 0.7 patterns.ts fabrication threshold for the same reason the 0.5 override-guess tier does. The SOURCE is the package, which is what owns a top-level type; measured on the corpus, 0 of 3227 files carrying an export set declare no package. `record_declaration` and `annotation_type_declaration` map to SymbolKind Class in this lane (mapTypeToSymbolKind), so the pins say class — the node type is recorded on the symbol's metadata.nodeType instead. Confidence is pinned EXACTLY on the 1.0 rows and with confidenceMax 0.6 on the package-private row, because a mutant that collapses the tier to a flat 1.0 was measured SURVIVING before those pins existed: metadata.exportForm alone did not catch it. A fixture that cannot fail is decoration.
